description: This file defines the HelpConfigService class in the OrangeHRM project, which extends a configuration service to provide specific methods for retrieving help-related configuration values such as processor class and help URL.

classes.name: HelpConfigService
classes.description: A service class that provides access to help-related configuration settings within the OrangeHRM platform.

methods.name: getHelpProcessorClass
methods.description: Retrieves the configured help processor class name.

methods.name: getBaseHelpUrl
methods.description: Retrieves the base URL for the help resources.
